reason: A queen duvet is a pain to wash at home and R$ 42 with the Bistek right there is easy to fit into a shopping trip. I would try it once, but only because the price is fair and the instructions look simple.
objection: I have never used a self-service laundry and I am afraid of messing up, like using the wrong cycle or shrinking or ruining the duvet. I also do not know anyone who has been there.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or neighbour recommending it, good Google reviews, or a staff member or attendant who can help me with the first wash.
